description: NaMg₄(AsO₄)₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅42d space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.36 Å) and four longer (2.73 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.36 Å) and four longer (2.73 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two MgO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.16 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two MgO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.16 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.19 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.19 Å. In the fifth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.16 Å. There are four inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-49°. There are two shorter (1.72 Å) and two longer (1.74 Å) As-O bond lengths. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-49°. There are two shorter (1.72 Å) and two longer (1.74 Å) As-O bond lengths. In the third As site, As is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-50°. All As-O bond lengths are 1.72 Å. In the fourth As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-49°. There are two shorter (1.72 Å) and two longer (1.74 Å) As-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Mg and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mg, and one As atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaMg₂As trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mg, and one As atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaMg₂As tetrahedra.
